notices.description:

Mayor Mamdani established the Office of Mass Engagement to transform how New Yorkers engage with their government, opening a direct line of communication between the Mayor, his team, and the people who built this city and keep it running. The Office of Mass Engagement works within City Hall and across City agencies to strategize, coordinate, and execute engagement that reaches the masses of everyday New Yorkers.

Notice of Intent to Issue New Solicitation(s) Not Included in FY 2027 Annual Contracting Plan and Schedule

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the mayor will be issuing the following solicitation(s) not included in the FY 2027 Annual Contracting Plan and Schedule that is published pursuant to New York City Charter § 312(a):

Agency: Department of Transportation

Description of Services to be Provided: The New York City Department of Transportation (NYC DOT), in partnership with the Department of Parks and Recreation (DPR) and the NYC Economic Development Corporation (EDC), is undertaking a community-based process to develop a plan to close gaps in current greenway infrastructure. Greenways are continuous, multi-use corridors designed for human-powered and electric-assist transportation and recreation. Greenways are inherently cross-jurisdictional, weaving between waterfronts, parks, and local streets. NYCs greenways connect the citys multitude of parks and open spaces while also linking major commercial, retail, and employment centers. The southern Bronx Waterfront along the East River comprises three distinct peninsulas: Hunts Point, Soundview/Ca…
notices.plain: The Mayor's Office of Contract Services says the city will issue a new solicitation for the Department of Transportation, which is not in its FY 2027 annual contracting plan, to help develop a community-based plan closing gaps in New York City's greenway network.
